run_metadata.coverage_summary: Tier 1 government portals (Commonwealth AusTender, NSW buy.nsw, VIC Buying for Victoria, QLD QTenders, WA Tenders WA, SA, TAS, NT QTOL, ACT) swept via web search; Tier 2 councils (VendorPanel), GBEs (Coliban Water, Power & Water NT, TasRail, TasNetworks) and universities/health (Austin Health, WA Country Health, TAS Health, UTAS) sampled; Tier 3 corporate channels (SAP Ariba Discovery, Rio Tinto Buy Local, EstimateOne) checked but login-gated with no publicly-visible RFx this run. Prioritised opportunities closing or published in the next few weeks / last 7 days.
gaps: CRITICAL ACCESS LIMITATION: this session's network policy blocked ALL direct HTTPS egress and WebFetch (403 CONNECT from the agent proxy for every host incl. example.com; DNS not resolved for the .gov.au and platform domains). No tender portal, detail page or document could be opened directly. Hosts requiring allow-listing include www.tenders.gov.au, www.tenders.nsw.gov.au/buy.nsw.gov.au, www.tenders.vic.gov.au, qtenders.epw.qld.gov.au, www.tenders.wa.gov.au, www.tenders.sa.gov.au, www.tenders.tas.gov.au, tendersonline.nt.gov.au, www.tenders.act.gov.au, www.vendorpanel.com.au, service.ariba.com, estimateone.com and all others.

Because of the above, ALL opportunities were discovered via the WebSearch tool only (search-index snapshots). Every entry is headline-level; deliverables, requirements, evaluation criteria, documents and contacts could NOT be extracted and are null. All closing dates/times need re-verification on the live portal.

Some web-search results were cached/aggregator snapshots with stale 'age' metadata; dates for aggregator-sourced items (noted in each tender's notes) are lower-confidence until verified on the buyer portal.
AusTender (Commonwealth): no specific new November-2026 ATM could be confirmed via search this run; federal listings require the live portal (blocked). Deferred to a future run with portal access.
Tenders SA: the search mostly returned South African ('SA') tenders; no confirmed South Australian government RFT closing in November 2026 was captured. SA coverage is a gap this run.

Tier 3 corporate (SAP Ariba Discovery, BHP/Rio Tinto/Fortescue/Woodside, Woolworths/Coles, Qantas, Telstra): no publicly-visible open RFx found; all are login/registration-gated. Portals recorded in discovered_sources. Invitation-only consultancy RFPs remain out of scope.

Ambiguous item not captured as a tender: a 'Campbelltown City Council clubhouse construction' listing could not be resolved to SA vs NSW (two councils share the name) and had no verifiable ID, so it was omitted rather than guessed.
recommended_seed_additions: Tasmanian Railway Pty Ltd (TasRail) e-Tendering - https://portal.tenderlink.com/tasrail/alltenders/ (GBE, TenderLink, free registration)
University of Tasmania (UTAS) e-Tendering - https://www.tenderlink.com/utas/ (university, TenderLink, free registration)
Commonwealth Supplier Portal / GovPanels - https://suppliers.tenders.gov.au/ (registration opened to all ABN businesses July 2026)
